# Global chip demand spikes, supply risk stays elevated  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter buying conditions this week; push for volume discounts and secure lead times now.

## What changed
- Market‑wide supply risk holds at 71.6 (up 0.7) and price trend climbs to 85.3 (up 0.1) – “Elevated” supply, “Rising fast” prices, confidence 84 % [1].  
- TSMC foundry loading surged 50.9 % YoY through Sep 2026, tightening supply across advanced logic [3].  
- A M6.1 earthquake 220 km from Renesas Naka/Takasaki fabs adds a near‑term supply shock [4].  
- Fab utilization sits at 76.5 % vs a 10‑yr average of 80 % – a modest loosening signal but outweighed by demand growth [5].  
- Industry demand growth (+148.3 % YoY) drives both price pressure and supply strain [2].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks, stock 27 081 units, no on‑order quantity or arrival data.  
- Price $5.56 qty‑1, $2.51 qty‑1 k; origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk 54.4 (Neutral), price trend 69.5; buy‑timing call **Hold course** – 59 % chance of price rise, no strong timing signal [6].

## Alerts
- **Earthquake** – M6.1 event 220 km from Renesas Naka/Takasaki fab cluster; potential disruption to Japanese MOSFET output [4].

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Elevated (71.0, 0.0), Rising (82.1), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – Elevated (72.5, +1.3), Rising (84.4), High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – Rising (68.4, 0.0), Rising (77.2), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – Rising (67.0, +0.3), Rising (77.9), High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – Rising (66.7, +0.4), Rising (82.8), High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **W25Q128JVSIQ** – supply risk 82.9; 52‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm.  
- **IRF540NPBF** – supply risk 82.2; 38‑week lead time, price +12.2 % vs target.  
- **SN65HVD230DR** – supply risk 81.9; 26‑week lead time, price +34.2 % vs target.  
- **LM358DR** – supply risk 81.6; 26‑week lead time, price +25.6 % vs target.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – supply risk 81.3; 26‑week lead time, price –0.9 % vs target.

## Outlook
- Chip prices next 3 months: 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.17 % (range –9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge.  
- Chip prices next 6 months: 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.34 % (range –8.79 % to +17.46 %); baseline trend.  
- Fab utilization next 3 months: 63 % chance of tighter supply, expected +1.82 pts (range –1.71 to +5.36 pts).  
- Fab utilization next 6 months: 60 % chance of tighter supply, expected +3.64 pts (range –2.16 to +9.45 pts).  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock volume now** on high‑risk parts (W25Q128JVSIQ, IRF540NPBF) to capture current pricing before the 52‑week and 38‑week lead‑time spikes translate into higher costs.  
2. **Request supply guarantees** or priority allocation for the featured MOSFET (IPB017N10N5ATMA1) despite its neutral risk, citing the recent earthquake risk to Japanese fabs.  
3. **Push for price‑break clauses** on analog parts with >25 % price‑vs‑target gaps (SN65HVD230DR, LM358DR) to mitigate the 70‑80 % price‑trend scores.
